back: An area with very low rainfall (often under about 250 mm a year), very high evaporation and sparse vegetation.
An area with low, unreliable rainfall (often about 250-500 mm a year), a long dry season and drought-resistant vegetation.
Removal of loose dust and sand by the wind, leaving hollows and desert pavement.
Sandblasting of rock by grains carried in the wind; strongest within about 1-2 m of the ground.
Suspension (fine dust, high in the air), saltation (sand bouncing in hops), surface creep (larger grains rolled along).
Barchan: crescent across the wind, horns point downwind, one main wind direction. Seif: long ridge parallel to the wind, winds from two directions.
Subtropical high pressure (sinking air), cold ocean currents, rain shadow and continentality.
Zeugen: flat-topped ridges on horizontal hard and soft layers. Yardangs: ridges on vertical bands parallel to the wind.
Mesa: flat-topped hill with a cap rock, wider than high. Butte: smaller remnant, higher than wide.
The south-east lowveld (Save-Limpopo), the Zambezi valley and south-western Matabeleland (natural region V and drier parts of IV).
